name: Cosmic Girls
source:
'Cosmic Girls' is about a high school student named Yabuki Kouji, a member of 'The Heroine Squad.' This squad, along with a group of beautiful girls, rises against the enemy, who is trying to conquer space.

The girls heal your exhaustion with sexual services, so you'll be able to fight against the enemy even longer!

[Edited From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050204195032/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ka/gaia_sp_box/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
《宇宙少女》讲述了“女主角小队”成员、名叫矢吹浩二的高中生的故事。这支小队与一群美丽的女孩一起奋起反抗试图征服太空的敌人。

女孩们通过性服务治愈你的疲惫，让你能够与敌人战斗得更久！

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050204195032/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ka/gaia_sp_box/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
